what: Enables reading from & writing to PSRC's internal file storage
title: Enables reading from & writing to PSRC's internal file storage
text: Read write files PSRC SharePoint site drives small set functions built Microsoft365R. Text-file delimiters follow file extension: .csv .txt use commas, .tab uses tabs. package connects PSRC tenant specified drive site. Temporary local copies removed function finishes. Excel reads support .xls .xlsx workbooks. Writes replace existing destination default; set overwrite = FALSE refuse upload destination already exists.
